title: Append dropped items to the list handling the drop event
body:
Append the new list item to event.currentTarget in the drag-and-drop example.

The handler is attached to the ol. When a drop targets an existing li and bubbles to the list, event.target is that li; appending there nests the new item inside it. currentTarget keeps the destination as the list.

Spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dnd.html#event-drag
